scripts.sync: cd backend && uv sync --extra test --extra data && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.init: uv run --project backend commerce-trace init --profile test --if-empty
scripts.dev: npm run backend & npm run frontend
scripts.test: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/commerce-trace-uv-cache PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONPATH=.. uv run pytest -p pytest_asyncio.plugin tests ../data_generator/test_generate.py && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/commerce-trace-uv-cache PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONPATH=.. uv run pytest -p pytest_asyncio.plugin tests ../data_generator/test_generate.py
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && uv run mypy src/commerce_trace && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:backend: cd backend && uv run mypy src/commerce_trace
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check src tests ../data_generator
